programme.title: Saajan Ki Bahon Mein
programme.desc: Sagar and Sapna reunite after years apart, only to find their lives have moved on - he's marrying Kavita, she's engaged to Rakesh. Their hearts face a quiet storm.

programme.title: Krishna
programme.desc: Krishna, wrongfully imprisoned for seven years, is released and aided by a minister on a covert mission. His quest for justice is intertwined with action, suspense, and his battle against injustice.

programme.title: Gambler
programme.desc: Though Inspector Dayashanker is lazy, he unwittingly unearths a criminal conspiracy and becomes the pride of his division overnight. However, the local gangsters turn his life into a living nightmare.

programme.title: Maha Sangram
programme.desc: Vishal, a farmer, sends his brother, Arjun, to the city for higher education. However, when Arjun falls in love with a girl in the city and gets murdered by her father, Vishal seeks revenge.

programme.title: Marte Dum Tak
programme.desc: Police Inspector Rane gets framed for murder. On release from prison, he becomes Rana, an underworld operator intent on seeking revenge.

programme.title: Dadagiri
programme.desc: Singh offers to marry Deepa and for her dad's sake, Deepa agrees, and a heartbroken Dharma decides to remain single.

programme.title: Gunda Gardi
programme.desc: Kalicharan, a ruthless gang leader, terrorises the city. To stop his reign, Police Commissioner Karan Singh is assigned the mission to bring him down.

programme.title: Bomb Blast
programme.desc: Jai Kishen is an aspiring police officer who marries his ladylove against his parents' wishes. MLA Sadakhare hires some men to carry out a bomb blast.

programme.title: Mast
programme.desc: Kittu is smitten by actress Mallika to the point of obsession. He abducts her when he finds that she is being illtreated by her family.

programme.title: King Uncle
programme.desc: Industrialist Ashok Bansal's harsh ways push away his siblings. But when orphan girl Munna enters their lives, she slowly softens his tough heart and changes the family.

programme.title: Nakabandi
programme.desc: Veera wants revenge for his parents' murder. But Kaalia, Raja's uncle, manipulates the bond between brothers, turning love into suspicion and loyalty into a dangerous test.

programme.title: Khoon Bhari Maang
programme.desc: Widow Aarti is trapped by Sanjay's plan to marry and kill her for her wealth. With help from her friend Nandini, she survives and fights back for justice and revenge.

programme.title: Kasam Suhaag Ki
programme.desc: A wounded serpent seeks revenge on the killers of her husband. Does she finally manage to succeed in her mission?

programme.title: Gurudev
programme.desc: Police Inspector Dev and Guru are childhood friends. Dev's father works as the right-hand man of criminal, who also happens to be Guru's father.

programme.title: Gangster
programme.desc: Simran moves to Seoul and finds herself torn between her past with Daya, a gangster, and her present love, Akash, a charming singer. Will she follow her heart?

programme.title: 23 March 1931 Shaheed
programme.desc: After the brutal murder of his mentor Lala Lajpat Rai by British authorities, Bhagat Singh seeks vengeance, ultimately leading to his death sentence for killing a British official.

programme.title: Eena Meena Deeka
programme.desc: Deeka, newly released from prison, unexpectedly finds herself in the middle of a bank heist led by the clever Eena. Get ready for a wild ride of twists!

programme.title: Raju Ban Gaya Gentleman
programme.desc: A young man Shahrukh Khan romances a beautiful woman while dreaming of success as an engineer.

programme.title: Naseeb Apna Apna
programme.desc: She thought she was marrying into a new life. Instead, she walks into a home where the groom's father hides a second, secret marriage - and the truth is far from simple.

programme.title: Prem Shakti
programme.desc: Kind-hearted Shakti and brave Prem fight against evil forces threatening their kingdom, discovering love, destiny and supernatural powers that shape their heroic journey.

programme.title: Kishen Kanhaiya
programme.desc: One mansion-raised, one street-smart-Kishen and Kanhaiya reunite after years apart. The twist? They're twins! And now, it's double trouble for the villains trying to tear their world apart.

programme.title: Maine Pyar Kiya
programme.desc: Prem and Suman's love faces tough challenges when family pressures and expectations come into play. Can their bond withstand the storms, or will love be overshadowed by family drama?

programme.title: Juaari
programme.desc: The story revolves around Rakesh Shashi Kapoor, who takes up alcohol after Sumitra breaks his heart and marries a rich and influential businessman

programme.title: Ghayal Once Again
programme.desc: When a video of his mentor's murder surfaces, an investigative journalist takes action to find those responsible.

programme.title: Mashooq
programme.desc: Karan and Neha fall in love and unaware of their families deadly rivalry.

programme.title: Police Aur Mujrim
programme.desc: A gangster is out for blood after his henchmen get locked up by the police. Fueled by vengeance, he's determined to make them pay for their betrayal.

programme.title: Dil Ka Kya Kasoor

programme.title: Sansar
programme.desc: A family faces tough times and strained relationships, but the determined leading lady steps up to bring everyone back together and heal their bonds.

programme.title: Hero Hindustani

programme.title: Avtaar
